_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: What the user says holds no secret is sent as typed, until something else is found. The screen is the default 393x727 phone. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} exists. Call "stored" returns the IDs of the secrets the server has stored for it, as a JSON array. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does (visible elements only); "named X" means an exact name match. "The composer" is [data-testid="message-input"], "the row" [data-testid="secret-bar"] and "its button" [data-testid="secret-bar-action"]. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Fill the composer with "example: postgres://demo:Qv7nLx2WpR9kT4@localhost/demo". 3. The row should contain the text "Captured on send" (allow 10s), and its button should have exactly the text "Don't capture". 4. Click its button: the row should contain the text "Sent as text". Click its button: the row should contain "Captured on send". Click its button again: it should have exactly the text "Capture". 5. A new finding is captured with the rest, until it is gone again. Fill the composer with "example: postgres://demo:Qv7nLx2WpR9kT4@localhost/demo and postgres://demo:Hd4sYt8MzJ3cW6@localhost/demo": the row should contain "Captured on send". Fill the composer with "example: postgres://demo:Qv7nLx2WpR9kT4@localhost/demo": the row should contain "Sent as text". 6. Click [data-testid="send-button"]. The composer should have the value exactly "". 7. The first ".messages-container .message-user" containing "Qv7nLx2WpR9kT4" should be visible, and there should be no ".messages-container .secret-pill" (count 0). 8. Call "stored": it must return [].
